calibrationNote: Up 0.05 to 8.65, back to my w49 level. (1) The q15 cover width is fixed. On one mask applied to all three images, the centre covers are 70-73 px wide (w50 72-79, photo 69-74), and the top rose 3 px (246-247 vs 249-250). The foot rose 6 px (293 vs 299, photo 290-295). (2) The wing rolls are now visibly behind the flap face. e3_side shows the flap standing proud of a slimmer roll, and e4_head shows the flap edges lying over the rolls with a step, as y_47303 shows. (3) A correction to my own w50 diagnosis. The q17 near-flap outline did not move when the roll moved 2 cm aft: the mask XOR between rD and rC is 175 px, from the 1 cm width change, and diff17.png shows that only the roll texture beside the flap changed. So the diagonal lower-right edge of the q17 flap is the flap's own side edge in projection; the roll was not covering it. y_47303's flap has the same diagonal right edge. The q17 deficit is entirely flap size and placement (w50b-2). The blob is 97 x 78 px against the photo's 79 x 100, its foot is 240 against 283, its top 163 against 183, and its area 3510 against 4224. Headrest 8.4 -> 8.5. The detail mean is 8.52. Nothing else changed.
